geometry: 29 by 14 canvas with a dark bordered gradient panel and explicit white X and 1 glyph paths. The glyphs span approximately y=3 to 11, with the X at x=2 to 8 and the 1 at x=12 to 13.
limitations: The smooth diagonal X approximates the antialiased pixel glyph rather than reproducing its raster edges. Native and 8x renders were visually inspected.
